build_autoencoder_model: build a linear autoencoder model with configurable feature, hidden, and latent dimensions plus dropout
run_autoencoder_forward: run the autoencoder forward pass to normalize, encode, decode, and denormalize input features
run_autoencoder_learn: run the autoencoder learn step to compute MSE loss on features with optional stats update
review_autoencoder_feature_dim: review the autoencoder Model class and its feature_dim method to inspect encoder input size
review_autoencoder_latent_dim: review the autoencoder Model class and its latent_dim method to inspect decoder input size
